Adverse renal effects of azacitidine include abnormalities in renal-function tests, renal tubular acidosis, renal failure, and death. US licensed product in- formation recommends that if serum-bicarbonate concentrations fall to below 20 mEq/litre, the dose of azacitidine should be halved for the next course. If there are rises in serum concentra- tions of urea or creatinine, the next cycle of azacitidine should be delayed until these return to normal or baseline, and the dose should be halved on the next treatment course.
